授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
本講義では無機材料の結晶構造と物性を勉強します。
The main form is commentary by the teacher in charge of the lesson.
Lecture materials will be uploaded to Moodle in advance, so please download them yourself. Online lectures will be given at Zoom.
A report will be imposed after each lecture, so please submit it by the designated time.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: In this study, crystal structure and functional property of various inorganic materials will be explained.
